anchor: OWHS proposal (RFC 0003); group-level metrics in a ProviderReturn
notes: Every metric counts people, never contacts or sessions. No metric carries clinical content. Definitions are OWHS proposals; no government or industry body has published a provider return format.

values.label: Distinct people who used the service at least once in the period
values.owhsFields: BenefitUtilisation.n (distinct people; usageCount counts events, not people)

values.label: New cases opened in the period. One case is one person; a person with two cases in the period is counted once
values.owhsFields: distinct people with an OHEpisode.referralDate in the period (BenefitUtilisation.claimCount counts events, not people)

values.label: Median working days from referral or first request to the provider's first contact with the person, for cases opened in the period
Share of cases opened in the period where first contact was within 10 working days of referral
Cases opened in the period where the person was absent from work when the case opened
Of the people in the cohort who were absent when their case opened, those who returned to work (rtw-outcome full, phased or adjusted)
Of the people in the cohort who returned to work, those still at work 26 weeks later
Closed cases where the provider does not know the work outcome
values.owhsFields: ReturnToWorkOutcome.sustainedAt status unknown; absent outcome record
